name: White Potato

pros.title: very practical staple food
pros.explanation: Cheap, common, and easy to build meals around.

pros.title: can be fairly filling
pros.explanation: Especially when eaten in less processed forms.

pros.title: flexible meal base
pros.explanation: Baked, boiled, or mashed, it pairs easily with stronger foods.

cons.title: needs cooking before it works
cons.explanation: It is not a grab-and-go food.

cons.title: prep method changes it fast
cons.explanation: Fries, butter, and heavy toppings can drag it down.

cons.title: plain flavour often needs help
cons.explanation: The simple potato does not always stay simple.
